b'# Project README

## Usage

The CLI tool is invoked from the command line.

## Commands and Options

### General Usage

The basic syntax is:
`tinydl <url> [options]`

### Options

| Option | Long Form | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `-o` | `--output` | File to write the downloaded content to (default: stdout). |
| `-q` | `--quiet` | Suppress progress output. |

### Positional Arguments

| Argument | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `url` | The URL of the content to download. |
